build_HydraModel: build a HydraModel with a backbone and output heads for predicting atomic properties from AtomicData
create_BackboneInterface_subclass: create a subclass of BackboneInterface implementing forward, build_inference_settings, and validate_atoms_data methods
create_HeadInterface_subclass: create a subclass of HeadInterface implementing forward to predict targets from backbone embeddings
add_tasks_HydraModel: add inference-only tasks like forces or stress to an existing HydraModel using add_tasks
prepare_HydraModel_for_inference: prepare a HydraModel for inference by calling prepare_for_inference with AtomicData and InferenceSettings
